texts.zh:
[Root.GetAdj]的外交团听闻[scandal_empire.GetName]最新报道的新闻之后举团震惊。我们一直驻留在当地的[event_envoy.GetAmbassadorOrNot][event_envoy.GetName]，让[event_envoy.GetHerselfHimself]陷入了严重的[scandal_empire.GetAdj]法律纠纷。[event_envoy.GetSheHeCap]目前深陷一场桃色事件，涉及到了一连串极其严重的罪行，甚至还牵涉到一场极其残忍的双人谋杀。

随着局势发展——当然谣言已经在[scandal_empire.GetSpeciesNamePlural]人群间满天飞——看上去[event_envoy.GetName]的罪行已经板上钉钉了。[scandal_empire.GetAdj]当局要求撤销[event_envoy.GetHerHis]的外交豁免权，这样[event_envoy.GetSheHe]就能因为[event_envoy.GetHerHis]的所作所为接受法律与正义的审判。
texts.en:
The [Root.GetAdj] diplomatic corps has been shaken by the news emerging from the [scandal_empire.GetName]. Our [event_envoy.GetAmbassadorOrNot] [event_envoy.GetName], who had been stationed there, has gotten [event_envoy.GetHerselfHimself] into a serious mess with [scandal_empire.GetAdj] law enforcement. [event_envoy.GetSheHeCap] [event_envoy.GetIsAre] currently in connection with a salacious affair involving an astonishing range of serious crimes that culminated in a brutal double murder.

As matters stand - and with rumors running wild among the [scandal_empire.GetSpeciesNamePlural] - there seems little doubt as to [event_envoy.GetName]'s guilt. The [scandal_empire.GetAdj] authorities have requested that [event_envoy.GetHerHis] diplomatic immunity be lifted so that [event_envoy.GetSheHe] can face justice for [event_envoy.GetHerHis] deeds.

summary.text:
# 色事孽务 / A Salacious Affair

> 本文为人工审阅导读（评注），不是游戏原文；原文见阅读器。 / Reviewer guide (commentary), not original game text; the original text is in the reader.

- 分类 Category：C8 银河轶事 / Galactic miscellany
- 来源 Sources：`events/envoy_events.txt:3262-3378`; `common/on_actions/00_on_actions.txt:576-592`
- 审阅 Reviewed：2026-10-13（已审阅 reviewed）

## 如何开始 How it starts

Galactic Community 特使的随机事件：五年脉冲（action.2211）的负面列表 on_five_year_random_pulse_country_negative_list，权重见分支栏（common/on_actions/00_on_actions.txt:576-592）；on_action 会先检查事件触发条件、不满足的从列表中剔除，所以只要有一个能触发就必有一个触发。通常共用5400天的 recent_envoy_event 冷却。 本事件：特使涉入某国的丑闻（scandal_empire）；无 recent_envoy_event；权重20/180。

A random Galactic Community envoy event: the negative list of the five-year pulse (action.2211), on_five_year_random_pulse_country_negative_list, weights in the branches (common/on_actions/00_on_actions.txt:576-592); on_actions check each event's trigger first and drop the failing ones, so as long as any can fire one always does. Most share a 5400-day recent_envoy_event cooldown. This event: An envoy implicated in a scandal in some country (scandal_empire); no recent_envoy_event; weight 20 of 180.

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

选项一：解除豁免（特使被清除；花30影响力，否则3600天的“外交使团是个笑话”修正）；选项二：为其安全召回（特使成逃亡者 fugitive_envoy，对方获得 opinion_envoy_murder_scandal）。

Option one: lift the immunity (the envoy is removed; costs 30 influence, otherwise the 3600-day "diplomatic corps is a joke" modifier); option two: recall for his own protection (the envoy becomes a fugitive_envoy and the scandal country gets opinion_envoy_murder_scandal).

## 分支与结局 Branches and outcomes

二选一。

One of two.

## 条件与文明差异 Conditions and variants

无。

None.

## 审阅记录 Review notes

核对了脚本触发和选项；与同一列表中的其他事件互相独立。

Trigger and options were checked against the script; independent of the other events in the same list.
